final:
next_state(s: int) -> int =
  pre s >= 0
  pre s < 2147483648
  post out >= 0
  post out < 2147483648
  ex next_state(0) == 12345
  (s * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648

shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 7) == []
  ex shuffled([4], 7) == [4]
  var ys = copy xs
  var state = seed % 2147483648
  let n = ys.len()
  for k in range(1, n)
    let i = n - k
    state = next_state(state)
    let j = (state // 16) % (i + 1)
    let a = ys[i]
    let b = ys[j]
    ys[i] = b
    ys[j] = a
  ys
